items.mainDefect: Concurrent builds for the same NamespacedResource can collide on the same on-disk index directory, causing errors or corruption.

secondary.defect: Concurrent cache overwrites discard the losing index without closing it, leaking file handles and memory.

items.mainDefect: Skipping the instrumentation integration test on postgres removes coverage that would detect a broken metrics endpoint.

secondary.defect: The unconditional postgres skip also disables local runs even though the stated problem is specific to Drone.

items.mainDefect: Running full initialization synchronously inside NewResourceServer blocks construction on storage and search I/O, breaking callers expecting cheap construction.

secondary.defect: Initialization failures now return no server, breaking callers that previously handled Init errors while retaining the server for degraded operation.

items.mainDefect: Concurrent builds for the same NamespacedResource can collide on the same on-disk index directory, causing errors or corruption.

secondary.defect: Last-writer-wins cache updates allow a stale snapshot to overwrite a fresher index.
